_source: RQ-0110 S1, S2: REST API Developer Guide — sObject Get Deleted (resources_getdeleted.htm), Get a List of Deleted Records Within a Given Timeframe (dome_get_deleted.htm). Shapes as documented; values illustrative, no org data. The error code for a start date outside the delete log window is the replication-date fault of the SOAP getDeleted call (medium confidence); the connector never sends such a window.

body.message: startDate must be within 15 days of the current date
